reading.zh: 先看 gm-console：场景里的 GM 控制台，已经在装可视化测试控件（开面板、切语言），新功能往这里加。后面五组是 OnGUI/启动探针，都挂在 TestScene 的 GameManager 上但 enabled=false，需手工开启才能跑。
reading.en: The GM console comes first: it is the in-scene dev console that already hosts test widgets (UI panels, language switch) and where new tools should be added. The five OnGUI/startup probes follow; they sit on TestScene's GameManager but are all disabled, so they must be enabled to run.
